concepts.description: SI units, least count, significant figures, measurement errors, and dimensional analysis applications.

concepts.subject: physics
concepts.description: Displacement current, electromagnetic wave characteristics, transverse nature, and electromagnetic spectrum.

source_refs.title: JEE Main 2027 Physics Unit 15: Electromagnetic Waves

concepts.subject: physics

source_refs.title: JEE Main 2027 Physics Unit 16: Ray Optics

source_refs.title: JEE Main 2027 Physics Unit 17: Dual Nature

concepts.name: Atoms and Bohr Model
concepts.subject: physics
concepts.description: Rutherford alpha scattering, Bohr model postulates, energy levels, and hydrogen emission spectrum.

concepts.subject: physics
concepts.description: Composition and size of nucleus, mass defect, binding energy per nucleon curve, and nuclear fission and fusion.

concepts.subject: physics
concepts.description: Basic and universal logic gates (OR, AND, NOT, NAND, NOR) and digital truth tables.

source_refs.title: JEE Main 2027 Physics Unit 19: Logic Gates

concepts.name: Vernier Calipers and Screw Gauge
concepts.subject: physics
concepts.description: Measurements of diameter, depth, thickness of thin sheet and wire using vernier calipers and screw gauge.

source_refs.title: JEE Main 2027 Physics Unit 20: Vernier and Screw Gauge

concepts.name: Mechanics Experimental Skills
concepts.subject: physics
concepts.description: Simple pendulum energy dissipation, metre scale principle of moments, and metallic wire Young's modulus.

source_refs.title: JEE Main 2027 Physics Unit 20: Mechanics Experiments

concepts.name: Fluids and Thermal Experimental Skills
concepts.subject: physics
concepts.description: Capillary rise surface tension, liquid terminal velocity viscosity, speed of sound resonance tube, specific heat.

source_refs.title: JEE Main 2027 Physics Unit 20: Fluids and Thermal Experiments

concepts.name: Electrical Experimental Skills
concepts.subject: physics
concepts.description: Metre bridge resistivity, Ohm's law wire resistance, and galvanometer figure of merit by half deflection.

source_refs.title: JEE Main 2027 Physics Unit 20: Electrical Experiments

concepts.name: Optics Experimental Skills
concepts.subject: physics
concepts.description: Focal lengths by parallax, prism angle of deviation, and glass slab refractive index using travelling microscope.

source_refs.title: JEE Main 2027 Physics Unit 20: Optics Experiments

concepts.name: Semiconductor and Electronic Component Skills
concepts.subject: physics
concepts.description: p-n junction diode forward/reverse curves, Zener breakdown voltage, and passive component identification.

source_refs.title: JEE Main 2027 Physics Unit 20: Semiconductor Experiments

concepts.name: Purification and Characterisation of Organic Compounds
concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.description: Purification techniques (crystallization, distillation, chromatography) and qualitative/quantitative elemental analysis.

source_refs.title: JEE Main 2027 Chemistry Unit 13: Purification and Characterisation

concepts.name: Diazonium Salts
concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.description: Preparation, chemical properties, synthetic importance of diazonium salts in organic transformations.

source_refs.title: JEE Main 2027 Chemistry Unit 18: Diazonium Salts

concepts.name: Qualitative Organic Analysis
concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.description: Detection of extra elements (N, S, halogens) and identification of functional groups in organic compounds.

source_refs.title: JEE Main 2027 Chemistry Unit 20: Qualitative Organic Analysis

concepts.name: Chemical Preparations in Laboratory
concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.description: Inorganic preparations of Mohr's salt and potash alum; organic preparations of acetanilide and iodoform.

source_refs.title: JEE Main 2027 Chemistry Unit 20: Chemical Preparations

concepts.name: Titrimetric and Volumetric Analysis
concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.description: Acid-base indicators, redox titrations with KMnO4 against oxalic acid and Mohr's salt.

source_refs.title: JEE Main 2027 Chemistry Unit 20: Titrimetric Exercises

concepts.name: Qualitative Salt Analysis (Inorganic)
concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.description: Systematic wet tests for cations (Pb2+, Cu2+, Al3+, Fe3+, Zn2+, Ni2+, Ca2+, Ba2+, Mg2+, NH4+) and anions (CO3 2-, S 2-, SO4 2-, NO3 -, NO2 -, Cl -, Br -, I -).

source_refs.title: JEE Main 2027 Chemistry Unit 20: Salt Analysis

concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.description: Enthalpy of CuSO4 solution, neutralization enthalpy, lyophilic/lyophobic sol preparation, iodide-H2O2 kinetics.
